cave floor (the number is its level)

┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
▒ a STAIR (real stair pieces cut in the face; walked both ways)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle =
a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk
Plot lines by district: T = The Long Tunnel. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep
today's height. A PROPOSAL: nothing is built from it until mondo says so.
